_**1587, a Year of No Significance: The Ming Dynasty in Decline**_ ( [Chinese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traditional_Chinese_characters "Traditional Chinese characters") : 萬曆十五年 ; [pinyin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinyin "Pinyin") : _Wanli Shiwunian_ ) is the most famous work of the Chinese [historian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Historian "Historian") [Ray Huang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ray_Huang "Ray Huang") . First published by [Yale University Press](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yale_University_Press "Yale University Press") in 1981, [[ 1 ]]() it examines how a number of seemingly-insignificant events in 1587 might have caused the downfall of the [Ming dynasty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ming_dynasty "Ming dynasty") .
